svg.title: Scan a document on your phone and print it
svg.desc: The phone camera finds the edges of a paper page, straightens it, removes shadows, and adds it to a batch. Two pages are sent together, decrypted in memory on the Windows PC, printed, and the temporary files are deleted.

g.text: 1. Camera Scan: Auto quad edge detection, perspective correction & shadow removal
2. Batch Spool: Configure print settings once, bundle pages into a single PDF
3. Secure Dispatch: Windows host decrypts in memory, prints & purges cache

svg.text: Auto quad boundary lock & batch document print
Both pages spooled as one job

g.text: Temporary files shredded on job end

svg.text: All scans & configs remain strictly on this PC
Local-First • No Telemetry • No Cloud Storage

g.text: 2 pages, TLS encrypted directly to Windows PC

svg.text: Thermal, Inkjet, Laser or Virtual PDF
